info.title: Place preview — experimental MOCK contract draft
info.description: Default disabled (404). Opt-in app.place-preview.enabled=true is MOCK-only and uses main anonymous-session Bearer authentication (v1 contract 1.1.0). Trusted Servlet Principal ownership, no header/body owner or fake-login fallback. UI/navigation/data-policy agreement remains pending; do not deploy publicly. All bodies are no-store. No DB/place cache, reservation linkage or live calls. Optional explicit requirements return a transient recommendationPlan; query plus requirements define generation identity. No ETA or call authorization is inferred.

x-authentication-dependency: Uses main #21 merged at 1b37bc2: server-issued anonymous access token with stable subject. Real token HTTP integration is verified with scripts/preview-token-smoke.py; UI token storage and lifecycle remain #26.

post.description: Create an ephemeral session. No provider call. Creation is bounded but not idempotent; do not automatically retry.

200.description: MOCK contract result; not a real reservation.

404.description: PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND intentionally conflates unknown, expired, removed/restarted and foreign-owner IDs. It is NOT an acknowledgement of successful cancellation/closure. Hide old results; do not infer the cause, redispatch or restore them.

post.description: One async result. In-flight same generation/query joins; completed generation never replays places or re-dispatches. New intent increments generation. No polling/cache.
